posts.name: Harshita Tripathi
posts.cooked:
My laptop is not working. I have submitted first 3 BPT using my old laptop which is not working now. Now, how to submit the last one and the OPPE exam using my new one. Will my previous submission get affected??
Kindly help as the last deadline is on 7 th August, 2025

Regards and Thank you,

posts.name: Harshita Tripathi
posts.cooked:
Kindly reply. @Bharathi Ma’am.
@andrew @jkmadathil @kamala

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Hello,

You can submit your 4th BPT and give OPPE exam on the new one, there will be no issues. Course VM is not affected by the OS or laptop you use. It’s the same thing as you using gmail, it works irrespective of the device used and your previous submissions will also be present on the VM (BPTs 1, 2 & 3). Just follow the same procedure (using ssh-keygen) as you did at the start of the term.

Kindly note tag course instructors or TAs for course related queries not the POD team.

Thanks & Regards,
Swati Jain
